rca_of_the_issue: The original bug was CORS violation when using axios with withCredentials:true. The Kubernetes proxy at preview.emergentagent.com adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* header, which conflicts with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true (browsers reject this combination). Fix: 1) Removed withCredentials:true from all axios calls. 2) Changed download functions to use native fetch() instead of axios to avoid interceptor interference. 3) Auth token passed as query parameter for downloads.
